主要内容: On March 14, 2016, Insperity, Inc. entered into Amendment No. 4 to its Credit Agreement, which increased the maximum borrowing amount from $125 million to $200 million and the potential increase in the credit facility from $175 million to $250 million. The amendment was filed as Exhibit 99.1 and is subject to the full text of the amendment. The filing was signed by Daniel D. Herink, Senior Vice President, Legal General Counsel and Secretary of Insperity, Inc.
